title: Mansion with endless doors that lead to different places in mallworld
content: Just found this sub and I'm amazed by how many others have experienced similar things and decided to share mine. One of my earliest dreams like this was over 7 years ago and they have only increased in both frequency and lucidity since. It took place in a large mansion with hundreds of rows of doors on each floor. I find I'll go through one and it takes me to specific parts of my mallworld that either I recognize or sometimes don't, but feel very familiar so I know they're in the same world. My dreams don't all start at the mansion, however I find myself returning to it generally before going to a new area which I'll then have reoccurring dreams within from anywhere between days to years. When moving between different parts of the areas I'm in I frequently find it's also by doors and the deeper I go into these individual locations the more dangerous and scary it seems to become, regardless of how many times I've revisited it. I know with certainty I've gone through doorways in/connecting to the mansion that lead to places such as; both a highschool and middle school, caves with minecarts and a train, downtown area of a city where everything is blindingly white, a cathedral, a gothic castle with nearly endless winding staircases, some sort of laboratory or testing facility, massive thrift store, factory with large pits of orange liquid and high windows where skylight comes through, a cabin in the middle of the forest (possibly part of some larger resort), a theatre entryway with floors both above and beneath it that also connect to other places, an aviary without any birds or plants, a skiing facility, huge department store like Ikea but all on one floor, library with endless rows of books, an indoor playground for children, an arcade, house in a neighbourhood running a daycare business upstairs with a bowling alley and bar in the basement, some kind of amusement park and/or waterpark, and then a few real life places such as Laser Quest, Chuck E Cheese, and Halloween Town. This mansion seems to be the hub in my mallworld that acts as a directory to move between places that are separated by greater distances, whereas places closer together are accessible by stairs and hallways.
